what: Several cards (12 in the original) line up in a spiral around an ellipse at the center of the board (radii 38.5% of board width · 35% of height). Neighbor spacing narrows by a ratio of .88 across .62 of a turn, size shrinks from 1.25x at the front card to .4x at the last card, opacity falls to .22 at the end, and cards past 35% of the order blur up to 1.6px. By sin(angle), cards lower down (in front) are bigger (.82 → 1) and darker (.65 → 1), and stacking comes on top too. The ring rotates straight at .09 rad per second, and when scroll is set it turns that many extra rad per scrolled screen

options.span: Share of the wheel the card takes, default .62
options.blur: Max blur of deep cards (px), default 1.6 — 0 turns it off
options.speed: Radians per second, default .09 — 0 stops it
options.scroll: Extra rad rotated per scroll screen, default 0 (original orbit=2 is 1.4)
options.rx·ry: Ellipse radii (share of panel width and height), default .385 · .35 — under 600 width, .58 · .37
options.--fx-card-w·--fx-card-ratio: Card width and ratio (CSS variables), default clamp(150px,14vw,270px)·1.45/.74, phone 46vw

note: On the original first page, the showreel video shrinks and settles into the first slot of this ring (pull) and the lead card grows into the first case’s place (push) — this ring is used for that transition. The transition is a page mechanism, so it exists only in the site copy (index.js). Put the centered intro text above the cards (z-index 50 or higher).
